_note: v5 layout variants (PRD R4/R5), derived from the APPROVED company references (config/brand_refs.json; analysis brand/reference-analysis.md). The Phase D directions were competitor-derived and are moved to the competitor archive (never read). Categories: carousel = Instagram carousel 1:1 (5-6 slides), fb_single = Facebook post 4:5, fb_ad = Facebook ad 4:5, li_single = LinkedIn post 3:4. Ids with R are founder variants (Roman by his LoRA on ComfyUI/RunPod). treatment = background treatment; rotation never repeats the previous variant and never uses one treatment three times in a row on a platform. The image model draws the picture only (designer prompt: config/designer_prompts.json); the app draws the exact German text, the official logo and the website. Built by the v5 run 2026-10-19.

contentTypes.service_intro: introduce a service or what Branded Genius builds
contentTypes.capabilities: what a service can do, as 3-6 concrete capabilities
contentTypes.risk: a risk or the cost of doing nothing
contentTypes.myth: a common belief that is wrong
contentTypes.process: how something works, step by step
contentTypes.onboarding: how working with Branded Genius starts
contentTypes.overview: a complete system or service at a glance
contentTypes.news: a news item and why it matters
contentTypes.tool_breakdown: one tool or system explained over several slides
contentTypes.founder_story: Roman at work, behind the scenes

consistent: brand.json colour tokens only (Royal Blue, Sky Blue, Medium Gray, White)
brand fonts (Futura, Jost fallback): at most 2 type families
the official logo file, placed by code with its clear space and minimum width
64 px minimum margin at 1080 px width
one accent colour per post (Sky Blue)
noText: no text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no labels, no UI, no charts, no screens, no logos, no signage, no documents, no placeholder boxes

outfits: dark navy blazer over a white open-collar shirt
charcoal knit sweater over a light shirt collar
light-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled up
black crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned grey overshirt

business: standing at a large blank glass wall in a bright modern meeting room, colleagues softly out of focus in the background
seated at a clean desk in a calm modern office with large windows, a laptop seen from behind
in a modern co-working space, standing by a window, people far in the background out of focus and turned away
walking through a bright modern office corridor with glass walls
quiet_luxury: on a quiet rooftop terrace at dusk with the city lights softly out of focus
in an elegant hotel lounge with warm light and soft leather armchairs, nobody else near
in a calm airport business lounge with large windows and aircraft far away out of focus
in a corner office with floor-to-ceiling windows and a city view at golden hour
in the back seat of a premium car, daylight through the window, city softly blurred outside

roman.alone: he is the only person in focus; anyone else is far away, out of focus, seen from behind or without a visible face
roman.noTextSurfaces: no readable screens, monitors, signs, papers, books or whiteboard writing anywhere (blank surfaces only)
roman.photoNotes: approvedPhotos: the real green-screen selfies used for LoRA v2 (docs/lora-training-results.md). 1, 3, 7 and 8 look like the same session but are not named there; 10-14 look AI-generated and are never used. Real photos are identity references only (LoRA training, the identity sheet at the person check): every image of Roman is generated by his LoRA on ComfyUI, never a real photo as the final image. portraitPhotos is unused (kept empty).
